Notes: First six of the season - C Nicholls pulled over mid wicket on to the club roof at Norton - 2 balls later sweet revenge as Mitchell out LBW
First maiden of the season and the honour goes to young Noah Payne - the over including 2 leading edges that just didnt carry back to him
And the frog in a blender strikes - Minto skips down the track and plays the wrong line and is castled by Mains
C&B chance - Nicholls juggles a mis timed drive from Symmington only for the chance to go begging
